model.pipeline: current NLPEngine: L1/L2 zoning+grounding, V3 relation scoring/gate, L3/L4 symbolic event+polarity, L5 Bayesian fusion

method.primary: frozen V7 full pipeline versus V6 symbolic ablation with V3 relation gate disabled
method.binary_gold: human_has_relation 1/0; EVALUATED_IN_COHORT is not counted as a predicted relation
method.relation_type: exact match on positive rows with human_relation_type != NONE
method.kg_gold: human_kg_viable YES/NO compared with actual L5 Contract D admission for the SRC/TGT pair

annotation_quality_audit.interpretation: This set evaluates the supplied human semantic labels; it does not independently establish biomedical truth or inter-annotator agreement.

direction_label_agreement_on_gold_relati.limitation: Gold NO combines reverse direction and unclear direction; agreement is against that combined annotation.

v3_probability_diagnostic.limitation: V3 is trained on BioRED relation labels; this is a domain-shift diagnostic, not calibrated probability validation for these semantic labels.
